info.name: SonarQube Cloud Web authentication notifications API
Add a notification for the authenticated user. Requires one of the following permissions: Authentication if no login ...

params.name: channel
params.description: Channel through which the notification is sent. For example, notifications can be sent by email.

params.name: type
params.description: Notification type. Possible values are for: Global notifications: CeReportTaskFailure, ChangesOnMyIssue, SQ-MyNewIssues Per project notifications: CeReportTaskFailure, ChangesOnMyIssue, NewAlerts, NewFalsePositiveIssue, NewIssues, SQ-MyNewIssues

items.docs: Add a notification for the authenticated user. Requires one of the following permissions: Authentication if no login is provided. If a project is provided, requires the 'Browse' permission on the specified project. If a project is provided, requires the 'Browse' permission on the specified project.
